products.title: ZERO GRIT RICH BROWN
products.body_html:
Zero Grit: an intersection of technical performance, health and fashion.

  • Water-repellent upper – stays dry in light rain.
  • Rubber toe and heel reinforcement – extra protection where you need it.
  • Water- and wind-repellent lining – locks in warmth on cold days.
  • Gusseted tongue – keeps water out and warmth in.
  • Reflective rear pull tab – maximizes visibility in low-light conditions.
  • 1.6 mm leather – durable enough for cold-weather wear but made to move.
  • Zero-drop outsole – no height difference between heel and toe.
  • Extra-wide toe box – room for the toes to splay and move the way they are meant to.
  • Hyper-flexible structure – sole and upper fold freely with the foot. No rigid midsole.
  • Made in Portugal.
  • The sneakers are packaged in a 100% recycled cardboard box.
